title: Weight presets schema
description: Schema for the L4 facility-ranking weight configuration. This file defines ranking features, which levels use weight-based ranking, default weights per level, user-selectable presets, safety bounds per level, and the emergency ranking strategy. THREE KEY PRINCIPLES: (1) Hard filters (department capability, operating status, distance range) and red-flag rules are NEVER affected by weights — they always take priority. (2) Presets and questionnaire-derived weights can only adjust within the bounds_by_level safety boundaries. (3) All numeric values (weights, bounds) are CONTENT to be authored in the C4 step; this schema only defines structure.

ranking_levels.description: Levels that use weight-based ranking. SELF_CARE does not go through L4. EMERGENCY_NOW uses emergency_ranking, not weights. Therefore ranking_levels can only contain SEE_DOCTOR_24_48H and/or BOOK_SOON.

default_weights_by_level.description: Keys are level_ids from ranking_levels. Values are objects mapping feature ids to numeric weights (0–1). The sum of weights for each level MUST be 1. Feature ids MUST be defined in the features array. These cross-field constraints are checked by the downstream validation script.

bounds_by_level.description: Safety boundaries. Keys are level_ids from ranking_levels. Values map feature ids to {min, max} clamps. These ensure that for levels requiring prompt care, user preferences cannot push long-wait or distant facilities to the top. Bounds MUST cover all features defined in the features array. This coverage constraint is checked by the downstream validation script.

higher_is_better.description: If true, a higher normalized score (0–1) is better. If false, a lower raw value is better (e.g. travel time).

scoring_note.description: Explains how this feature is converted to a 0–1 score. Content to be authored in a later step.

weights_by_level.description: Same structure as default_weights_by_level. Keys are level_ids from ranking_levels. The sum of weights for each level MUST be 1 and all feature ids must be defined in features. Checked by the downstream validation script.
